svg.text: Reproducibility of the optimum against dark-scan time: more counting helps only if the tail fit stops narrowing
(a) tube T1: P(two independent dark scans give optima within 0.2 mV), 0.2 mV light grid, light noise-free
all 21 sampling variants of 11, driver fit, light 13:59
straight-line tail fit above 6 mV, light 13:59
straight-line tail fit above 6 mV, light 17:24
(b) tube T2: P(two independent dark scans give optima within 0.2 mV), 0.2 mV light grid, light noise-free
all 21 sampling variants of 11, driver fit, light 13:59
straight-line tail fit above 6 mV, light 13:59
straight-line tail fit above 6 mV, light 17:24
Each point: 150 seeded scans of a tube with the tuned tail over-dispersion. Points of 11b, by time: 0.4 mV grid 30 s x1 and 120 s x2; 0.2 mV grid 60 s x4, 120 s x4, 240 s x2, 480 s x2, 960 s x2
(dwell per level over 5.6-10 mV x passes there). Source: out/11_summary.csv, out/11b_summary.csv.
